about: Expected answers under iteration 6 of the design (notes/iteration-6-design.md), written by Claude (the proof session) BEFORE any change was run on iteration 6. The writer had seen every earlier result; the next fresh adversarial round is the blind test. Where a change's answer is unchanged from iteration 5 it is copied.

V01-accepts-more-hides-static.why: Rule 27: Tally.sum is an entry of its own; its change tells billing whatever the constructor does.

V02-bound-values-in-mapped-list.why: Rule 32: the list a check runs over counts: the minutes bound counts as changed; billing uses MeterInput.

V03-refusals-through-console-error.why: Rule 30: console.error writes MeterMsg to stderr: meter's own check refuses.

V04-instance-built-in-a-conditional.why: Rule 31: money's own check refuses the class instance in a branch.

V05-error-kind-in-bound-test.why: Rule 32: the error kind named in the bound test changed: billing told; rule 29: money throws a kind its comment does not state: money's own check refuses.

V06-non-interface-file-renamed.why: Rule 28: front's set-up imports a file of bookings that is not an interface file: front's check refuses it, before and after, so that state could not have been merged.
V06-non-interface-file-renamed.guard: front's own check refuses the set-up (rule 28)

V07-write-with-callback.why: No refusal: write's callback is described, and only the data is checked.

V08-limit-read-from-json.why: No refusal: the reader reads JSON modules.

V09-pop-after-length-check.why: A new entry; pop() is 'cannot tell'; reports not followed.

V10-checked-cast-to-kind.why: A new entry; reports not followed.

V11-door-copy-in-two-steps.why: Door states new errors (told rightly); the copy in two steps is not a message: no refusal.

V12-destructured-parameter.why: Parameter names and shapes are left out of the printed declaration.

V13-states-named.why: A new entry (BookingState); Booking's printed declaration is the same with the named union written out; reports not followed.

V14-overload-added.why: Rule 33: an added overload that keeps the old one only accepts more.

V15-bound-test-through-helper.why: Rule 32: values handed to the helper's parameters are followed: same pairs.
